articles.title_en: From shocks to solidarity and superstition: Exploring the foundations of faith
articles.title_cn: 从冲击到团结与迷信：探索信仰的基础
articles.abstract_en: Additive shocks can substantially increase cooperation in otherwise standard public goods game experiments. We study shocks that randomly adjust players’ earnings by a fixed positive or negative amount reported at the end of each round. These adjustments change neither the return to players’ contributions nor the information about other group members. We compare results across four treatments that employ the same group-level adjustment algorithm but frame it differently, with pre-play descriptions that range from omitting all useful information to accurately revealing its 50/50 random nature. In each treatment, overall contributions run about 50% higher than those obtained in the standard no-adjustment game. Contributions run higher still, nearly 100% over baseline, in a treatment that individualizes the adjustments, truthfully describing them as 50/50 random and separately calculated for each player. Our results contrast with those of previous studies, which add risk to public goods games in ways that directly interact with players’ contributions and typically reduce cooperation. Players’ contributions and post-play feedback strongly suggest that our results trace back to a pair of deep-rooted impulses that boost solidarity in response to external risk and rationalize the response with superstitious thinking.
articles.abstract_cn: 加性冲击可以显著提高在标准公共品博弈实验中的合作水平。我们研究了随机调整玩家收益的冲击，这些冲击在每轮结束时以固定正或负金额报告。这些调整既不改变玩家对贡献的回报，也不改变关于其他小组成员的信息。我们比较了四种处理的结果，这些处理采用相同的组级调整算法，但以不同的方式框架化，其前期描述范围从省略所有有用信息到准确揭示其50/50随机性质。在每种处理中，总体贡献比标准无调整博弈中获得的贡献高出约50%。在一种将调整个体化、如实描述为50/50随机且为每个玩家单独计算的处理中，贡献更高，几乎比基线高出100%。我们的结果与之前的研究形成对比，那些研究以直接与玩家贡献互动的方式增加公共品博弈的风险，通常减少合作。玩家的贡献和博弈后的反馈强烈表明，我们的结果追溯到一对根深蒂固的冲动，这些冲动在外部风险下增强团结，并用迷信思维合理化这种反应。

articles.title_en: Expectational reference points and belief formation: Field evidence from financial analysts
articles.title_cn: 预期参考点与信念形成：来自金融分析师的实地证据
articles.abstract_en: We test the influence of expectations as reference points in the belief formation of individuals using field data from financial analysts. We explore the premise that deviations from expectations can significantly alter people's perceptions of identical outcomes, thereby affecting their subsequent belief formation. We employ a regression discontinuity design to reveal that analysts whose forecasts were barely exceeded become discontinuously more optimistic than analysts whose forecasts were barely missed, despite having converging prior beliefs and observing the same performance signal about firm earnings. Furthermore, our analyses show that analysts whose forecasts were barely missed update their beliefs more strongly than do analysts whose forecasts were barely exceeded. We contribute to the literature by providing important field evidence indicating that expectations constitute a reference point that influences subsequent belief formation in an environment involving high stakes and expert decision-makers.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用金融分析师的实地数据，检验了预期作为参考点对个体信念形成的影响。我们探讨了一个前提，即偏离预期可以显著改变人们对相同结果的感知，从而影响他们随后的信念形成。我们采用断点回归设计，发现预测勉强被超越的分析师比预测勉强未达的分析师变得不连续地更加乐观，尽管他们的先验信念趋同且观察到关于公司盈利的相同绩效信号。此外，我们的分析显示，预测勉强未达的分析师比预测勉强被超越的分析师更新信念的力度更强。我们通过提供重要的实地证据，表明预期构成了一个参考点，在高风险环境和专家决策者中影响随后的信念形成，从而为文献做出贡献。

articles.title_en: The impact of an SCHIP freeze on children and parent's health insurance coverage
articles.title_cn: SCHIP冻结对儿童及父母健康保险覆盖的影响
articles.abstract_en: Taking advantage of an Arizona children's health insurance program enrollment freeze, I study how the loss of children's public insurance affects children and parents. I confirm that the policy led to a decrease in public coverage among children and find partially offsetting gains in employer-sponsored insurance coverage. I find evidence that parents of affected children responded by enrolling in employer-sponsored plans rather than adjusting labor supply. Parents of slightly older children who were unaffected by the policy do not exhibit any responses to the freeze. These results can be informative of the ongoing Medicaid unwinding.
articles.abstract_cn: 利用亚利桑那州儿童健康保险计划注册冻结的机会，我研究了儿童公共保险的丧失如何影响儿童及其父母。我确认该政策导致儿童公共保险覆盖率下降，并发现雇主提供的保险覆盖有部分抵消性增加。我发现证据表明，受影响儿童的父母通过加入雇主提供的保险计划而非调整劳动力供给来应对。未受政策影响的稍年长儿童的父母对冻结没有表现出任何反应。这些结果可能对正在进行的医疗补助解除过程具有参考价值。

articles.title_en: Sequential contests with incomplete information: Theory and experimental evidence
articles.title_cn: 不完全信息下的序贯竞赛：理论与实验证据
articles.abstract_en: We investigate behavior in two-player sequential-move contests with complete and incomplete information about the value of the prize. First, we describe a Bayesian equilibrium in which both players have private prize values. Then, we test our predictions in the experimental laboratory. We analyze three settings: symmetric prize valuations with complete information, asymmetric prize valuations with complete information, and asymmetric prize valuations with incomplete information. We find that subjects’ behavior is less consistent with theory and more in line with simple mental shortcuts. Our data supports a simple investment heuristic for each player type. On average, first-movers invest half of their own valuation and second-movers, regardless of their prize valuation, invest frequently in one of the following ways: drop out of the contest or invest at or just above the first-movers’ investment. We add to the growing literature by showing that experimental contest data can be better explained by simple heuristics.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了在关于奖品价值具有完全和不完全信息的两人序贯移动竞赛中的行为。首先，我们描述了一个贝叶斯均衡，其中两个玩家都有私人奖品价值。然后，我们在实验室内测试我们的预测。我们分析了三种设置：完全信息下的对称奖品估值、完全信息下的不对称奖品估值以及不完全信息下的不对称奖品估值。我们发现，受试者的行为与理论的一致性较低，而更符合简单的心理捷径。我们的数据支持每种玩家类型的简单投资启发式。平均而言，先动者投资其自身估值的一半，而后动者，无论其奖品估值如何，经常以下列方式之一进行投资：退出竞赛或投资于等于或略高于先动者投资的水平。我们通过展示实验竞赛数据可以更好地由简单启发式解释，为日益增长的文献做出了贡献。

articles.title_en: The effect of health on the marginal utility of consumption: Evidence based on household consumption expenditure
articles.title_cn: 健康对消费边际效用的影响：基于家庭消费支出的证据
articles.abstract_en: This study uses broad-based measures of household consumption and a utility proxy to estimate the effect of health on the marginal utility of consumption, utilizing data from the Russia Longitudinal Monitoring Survey (1994–2019). To do so, I estimate how an observed within-individual utility change associated with a health shock varies across individuals of different consumption levels. The results indicate that the marginal utility of consumption increases as health deteriorates. Specifically, the baseline estimates show that moving from a healthy state to a poor health state raises the marginal utility of consumption by approximately 4 percentage points. In relative terms, a one-standard-deviation increase in poor health is associated with a proportional increase of 22.7% to 29.4% in the marginal utility of consumption relative to the marginal utility in a healthy state. These findings are primarily driven by the increased marginal utility of luxuries rather than necessities, suggesting that certain types of goods offer greater utility in poor health and play a crucial role in mitigating the adverse impacts of health shocks.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究利用俄罗斯纵向监测调查（1994-2019）的数据，采用广泛的家庭消费衡量指标和效用代理变量，估计健康对消费边际效用的影响。为此，我估计了与健康冲击相关的个体内效用变化如何在不同消费水平的个体之间有所不同。结果表明，随着健康状况恶化，消费的边际效用增加。具体而言，基线估计显示，从健康状态转变为较差健康状态会使消费的边际效用提高约4个百分点。相对而言，较差健康状态的一个标准差增加与消费边际效用相对于健康状态下的边际效用成比例增加22.7%至29.4%相关。这些发现主要由奢侈品而非必需品的边际效用增加所驱动，表明某些类型的商品在健康状况不佳时提供更大的效用，并在减轻健康冲击的不利影响中发挥关键作用。

articles.title_en: State-dependent impulse responses in agent-based models: A new methodology and an economic application
articles.title_cn: 基于主体的模型中的状态依赖脉冲响应：一种新方法及其经济应用
articles.abstract_en: The paper delves into the potential of Agent-Based Models (ABM) in analysing phenomena characterized by the non-linear propagation of shocks and system dynamics. Recognizing that state dependency can naturally emerge in complex evolving systems, we present a new methodological framework to evaluate state-dependent (or non-linear) impulse response functions in an ABM setting. Inspired by threshold time series modelling approaches, we propose analysing state-dependent impulse responses by creating alternative controlled states of the system, from which randomized impulse responses can be computed. Furthermore, a data-driven, machine-learning algorithm is proposed to endogenously identify relevant system states for the observed response. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first time such an approach is advanced. An R library implementing all the required methods is also offered to ensure applicability in diverse fields. Finally, the methodology is applied in economics to test for monetary policy shocks in a reference macro ABM, highlighting its effectiveness in mapping the system impulse response to the identified key state variables, as well as showing the importance of state dependence for policy design and systematic identification of critical system states.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文深入探讨了基于主体的模型（ABM）在分析以冲击非线性传播和系统动态为特征的现象方面的潜力。认识到状态依赖可以在复杂演化系统中自然出现，我们提出了一种新的方法论框架，用于在ABM环境中评估状态依赖（或非线性）脉冲响应函数。受阈值时间序列建模方法的启发，我们建议通过创建系统的替代控制状态来分析状态依赖的脉冲响应，从中可以计算随机脉冲响应。此外，提出了一种数据驱动的机器学习算法，以内生地识别观测响应相关的系统状态。据我们所知，这是首次提出这种方法。我们还提供了一个实现所有所需方法的R库，以确保在不同领域的适用性。最后，该方法被应用于经济学中，以测试参考宏观ABM中的货币政策冲击，突显了其在将系统脉冲响应映射到已识别的关键状态变量方面的有效性，以及展示了状态依赖对政策设计和关键系统状态系统识别的重要性。

articles.title_en: Trade uncertainty, emission cap and firm pollution
articles.title_cn: 贸易不确定性、排放上限与企业污染
articles.abstract_en: This study investigates the effects of reducing trade policy uncertainty (TPU) on firms’ production and pollution dynamics under different extents of environmental regulation stringency. We develop a trade model with heterogeneous firms subject to different regulatory pressures. Our calibration shows that reduced TPU boosts firm output by 6%, which persists even under stricter environmental regulations. Meanwhile, the emission cap control prominently reduces emissions and emission intensity. By constructing a firm-level TPU reduction shock following the U.S. granting of permanent normal trade relations to China, we empirically test our model’s predictions using Chinese data. Consistently, we find that while firms in both environmentally regulated and non-regulated zones increase output to similar extents, only those in Two-Control Zones with stringent sulfur dioxide (SO2) emission controls reduce their total emission intensity through decreased fossil fuel use, desulfurization, and increased investment in pollution abatement.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨了在不同环境监管严格程度下，降低贸易政策不确定性（TPU）对企业生产和污染动态的影响。我们构建了一个包含异质性企业且面临不同监管压力的贸易模型。校准结果显示，降低TPU使企业产出增加6%，即使在更严格的环境监管下这一效应依然存在。同时，排放上限控制显著减少了排放量和排放强度。通过构建企业层面的TPU降低冲击（以美国授予中国永久正常贸易关系为背景），我们利用中国数据实证检验了模型的预测。一致地，我们发现，虽然环境监管区和非监管区的企业产出增长幅度相似，但只有在实施严格二氧化硫（SO2）排放控制的两控区内，企业通过减少化石燃料使用、脱硫和增加污染治理投资，降低了总排放强度。

articles.title_en: Belief diversity and cooperation
articles.title_cn: 信念多样性与合作
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies a two-player game in which the players face uncertainty regarding the nature of their partner. In this variation of the standard Prisoner’s Dilemma, players may encounter an ‘honest’ type who always cooperates. Mistreating such a player imposes a moral cost on the defector. This situation creates a trade-off, resolved in favor of cooperation if the player’s trust level, or belief in their partner’s honesty, is sufficiently high. We investigate whether an environment where players have explicit beliefs about each other’s honesty is more or less conducive to cooperation, compared to a scenario where players are entirely uncertain about their partner’s beliefs. We establish that belief diversity hampers cooperation in environments where the level of trust is relatively low and boosts cooperation in environments with a high level of trust.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了一个两人博弈，其中玩家面临关于其伙伴性质的的不确定性。在这种标准囚徒困境的变体中，玩家可能会遇到总是合作的“诚实”类型。虐待这样的玩家会给背叛者带来道德成本。这种情况产生了一种权衡，如果玩家的信任水平，或对其伙伴诚实性的信念，足够高，则倾向于合作。我们研究了在玩家对彼此诚实性有明确信念的环境中，与玩家对其伙伴信念完全不确定的情景相比，是否更有利于合作。我们确定，在信任水平相对较低的环境中，信念多样性阻碍合作，而在信任水平较高的环境中则促进合作。

articles.title_en: Optional disclosure and observational learning
articles.title_cn: 选择性披露与观察性学习
articles.abstract_en: We examine how allowing individuals to self-determine whether to disclose their behavior to others can mitigate the disruptive effect of information cascades on the efficiency of observational learning. We theoretically analyze various disclosure strategies and show that observational learning can be more efficient under the optional disclosure condition if decision-makers adopt a selective disclosure strategy. However, data from a controlled laboratory experiment suggest that spontaneous disclosure decisions are not sufficiently selective. As a result, optional disclosure fails to increase learning efficiency. We further demonstrate that providing public information about the effects of disclosure behavior on others significantly improves learning outcomes.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了允许个体自行决定是否向他人披露其行为，如何减轻信息级联对观察性学习效率的破坏性影响。我们从理论上分析了各种披露策略，并表明如果决策者采取选择性披露策略，观察性学习在选择性披露条件下可以更有效率。然而，来自受控实验室实验的数据表明，自发的披露决策不够具有选择性。因此，选择性披露未能提高学习效率。我们进一步证明，提供关于披露行为对他人影响的公共信息能显著改善学习结果。

articles.title_en: Online training and financial incentives for teachers: Evidence from Bangladesh
articles.title_cn: 教师在线培训与财政激励：来自孟加拉国的证据
articles.abstract_en: Teacher training is costly and sometimes ineffective, especially if teachers are not fully engaged. This paper presents findings from a randomized evaluation of an incentivized online teacher training program implemented in Bangladesh during COVID-related school closures. One treatment group received training and the other also received a moderate financial incentive. Teachers enrolled in the program demonstrated improved math competencies in the short-run and medium-run after fifteen months (0.25 and 0.16 s.d.). The impact was two to three times larger when combined with financial incentives. Training combined with incentives also improved instructional practice, measured through online observations and self-reports (0.23 and 0.18 s.d.). Finally, online training reduced teacher burnout, with the impact lasting longer for the incentive group.
articles.abstract_cn: 教师培训成本高昂且有时效果不佳，尤其是在教师未充分参与的情况下。本文介绍了一项在COVID相关学校关闭期间于孟加拉国实施的激励性在线教师培训项目的随机评估结果。一个治疗组接受了培训，另一组还获得了适度的财政激励。参加该项目的教师在短期和十五个月后的中期均表现出数学能力的提升（分别为0.25和0.16个标准差）。当与财政激励相结合时，影响效果是原来的两到三倍。培训与激励相结合还改善了教学实践，通过在线观察和自我报告测量（分别为0.23和0.18个标准差）。最后，在线培训减少了教师职业倦怠，且对激励组的影响持续时间更长。

articles.title_en: Inequality, social norms and cooperation: Strategy choice in the infinitely socially iterated prisoner’s dilemma
articles.title_cn: 不平等、社会规范与合作：无限社会重复囚徒困境中的策略选择
articles.abstract_en: Societies today face important challenges related to cooperation, which is needed among individuals who interact at a nonregular frequency. In this context, cooperation can be sustained if social norms push in this direction. We design an online experiment in which participants make strategic choices in an infinitely socially iterated prisoner’s dilemma. We examine the effects of inequality on social norms of cooperation and how norm compliance, in turn, affects cooperation. Inequality exists when two participants defect and cooperation gives equal payoffs in one treatment or keeps the unequal payoffs in the other. The results show that inequality weakens social norms by limiting first- and second-order normative beliefs about cooperation as well as descriptive beliefs about the other participants’ cooperation. Inequality reduces the likelihood of cooperation mainly driven by the change in social norms. Overall, the mere existence of inequality causes these changes, not specific behaviors, depending on the participants’ type.
articles.abstract_cn: 当今社会面临与合作相关的重要挑战，这种合作需要在非规律频率互动的个体之间实现。在此背景下，如果社会规范推动合作，合作便得以维持。我们设计了一项在线实验，参与者在无限社会重复囚徒困境中做出策略选择。我们考察不平等对社会合作规范的影响，以及规范遵从如何反过来影响合作。不平等存在于两种处理中：一种处理中，当两名参与者背叛且合作带来相同收益时；另一种处理中，合作保持收益不平等。结果表明，不平等通过限制关于合作的一阶和二阶规范性信念以及关于其他参与者合作的描述性信念，削弱了社会规范。不平等降低了合作的可能性，这主要由社会规范的变化驱动。总体而言，仅是不平等的存在就导致了这些变化，而非特定行为，具体取决于参与者的类型。

articles.title_en: Agent-based models of the United States wealth distribution with Ensemble Kalman Filter
articles.title_cn: 基于集合卡尔曼滤波的美国财富分布基于主体模型
articles.abstract_en: The distribution of wealth is central to economic, social, and environmental dynamics. The release of high-frequency distributional data and the rapid pace of the complex global economy makes ‘real-time’ predictions about the distribution of wealth and income increasingly relevant. For instance, during the COVID-19 pandemic in spring 2020, the stock markets experienced a crash followed by a surge within a brief period, evidently reshaping the wealth distribution in the US. Yet economic data, when first released, can be uncertain and need to be readjusted — again specifically so during crisis moments like the pandemic when information about household consumption and business returns is patchy and drastically different from “business-as-usual”. Our motivation here is to develop one way of overcoming the problem of uncertain ‘real-time’ data and enable economic simulation methods, such as agent-based models, to accurately predict in ‘real-time’ when combined with newly released data. Therefore, we tested two distinct, parsimonious agent-based models of wealth distribution, calibrated with US data from 1990 to 2022, in conjunction with data assimilation. Data assimilation is essentially applied control theory — a set of algorithms aiming to improve model predictions by integrating ‘real-time’ observational data into a simulation. The algorithm we employed is the Ensemble Kalman Filter (EnKF), which performs well in the context of computationally expensive problems. Our findings reveal that while the base models already align well historically, the EnKF enables a superior fit to the data.
articles.abstract_cn: 财富分配对经济、社会和环境动态至关重要。高频分布数据的发布和复杂全球经济的快速发展使得对财富和收入分配的“实时”预测日益相关。例如，在2020年春季COVID-19大流行期间，股市经历了暴跌后迅速飙升，明显重塑了美国的财富分配。然而，经济数据在首次发布时可能不确定，需要重新调整——尤其是在像大流行这样的危机时刻，家庭消费和企业回报的信息零散且与“常态”截然不同。我们的动机是开发一种克服不确定“实时”数据问题的方法，使基于主体的模型等经济模拟方法能够结合新发布的数据进行“实时”准确预测。因此，我们测试了两种不同的、简约的基于主体的财富分配模型，使用1990年至2022年的美国数据进行校准，并结合数据同化。数据同化本质上是应用控制理论——一组算法，旨在通过将“实时”观测数据整合到模拟中来改进模型预测。我们采用的算法是集合卡尔曼滤波（EnKF），它在计算成本高的问题中表现良好。我们的研究结果表明，虽然基础模型在历史上已经很好地吻合，但EnKF能够实现对数据的更优拟合。

articles.title_en: Higher-order beliefs in a sequential social dilemma
articles.title_cn: 序贯社会困境中的高阶信念
articles.abstract_en: Strategic players must form beliefs about how others will react at future decision nodes. How often do such beliefs form a consistent hierarchy where subjects believe others hold beliefs similar to their own? We introduce a simple four-player sequential social dilemma where actions reveal first and higher-order beliefs. The unique sub-game perfect Nash equilibrium (SPNE) for self-interested players is observed less than 5% of the time, even though our diagnostic treatments show that a majority of our subjects are self-interested, higher-order rational and have accurate first-order beliefs. In our data, strategic play deviates substantially from Nash predictions because first-order and higher-order beliefs are inconsistent for most subjects, that is most subjects believe that other’s beliefs differ from their own beliefs. We construct and operationalize an epistemic model of belief hierarchies to estimate that less than 10% of subjects have consistent first and higher-order beliefs.
articles.abstract_cn: 战略参与者必须形成关于他人如何在未来决策节点做出反应的信念。这些信念多久能形成一致的层级结构，即参与者认为他人持有与自己相似的信念？我们引入了一个简单的四人序贯社会困境，其中行动揭示了一阶和高阶信念。自利参与者的唯一子博弈完美纳什均衡（SPNE）在不到5%的时间内被观察到，尽管我们的诊断性处理表明，大多数受试者是自利的、高阶理性的，并且具有准确的一阶信念。在我们的数据中，战略行为与纳什预测显著偏离，因为大多数受试者的一阶和高阶信念不一致，即大多数受试者认为他人的信念与自己的信念不同。我们构建并操作化了一个关于信念层级的认识论模型，以估计不到10%的受试者具有一致的一阶和高阶信念。

articles.title_en: Religion as an informal institution: A case of true pure land Buddhism and missing women in early modern Japan
articles.title_cn: 宗教作为非正式制度：日本近代早期真宗净土信仰与失踪女性的案例
articles.abstract_en: In early modern Japan, infanticide was used for birth control and sex selection. However, some historians hypothesized that people who believed in the True Pure Land (TPL) sect of Japanese Buddhism were less likely to commit infanticide. I statistically examine this hypothesis using a quasi-natural experiment of hinoeuma (fire-horse) year with a two-way fixed-effects estimation. Girls born in a hinoeuma year were reckoned to be inauspicious and subjected to sex-selective infanticide. In 1846 and 1906 hinoeuma, TPL-dominant areas experienced a smaller increase in the male-to-female ratio in the cohort than the areas with less TPL dominance. Additional regressions support the hypothesis that the TPL’s prohibition of infanticide led to this smaller effect.
articles.abstract_cn: 在近代早期的日本，杀婴被用于生育控制和性别选择。然而，一些历史学家假设，信仰日本佛教真宗净土（TPL）派别的人不太可能实施杀婴。我利用丙午（火马）年的准自然实验，通过双向固定效应估计，对这一假设进行了统计检验。在丙午年出生的女孩被认为不吉利，并遭受性别选择性杀婴。在1846年和1906年的丙午年，与TPL主导程度较低的地区相比，TPL主导地区队列中的男女比例增幅较小。额外的回归分析支持了TPL禁止杀婴导致这一较小效应的假设。

articles.title_en: Multitasking and leadership in optimal incentive contracts
articles.title_cn: 最优激励合同中的多任务与领导力
articles.abstract_en: We study multitasking problems where an agent engages in both a contractible and a non-contractible task, which are substitutes. The agent has private information on the value of the non-contractible task, and there are followers (e.g., another agent, a third party, or a principal) who also contribute to this task. The agent’s effort can serve as a signal of the value as in the literature on leading-by-example (Hermalin, 1998). We derive the condition in which the principal provides high-powered incentives for the contractible task to mitigate the agent’s excessive signaling.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究多任务问题，其中代理人同时从事一项可签约任务和一项不可签约任务，这两项任务是替代品。代理人拥有关于不可签约任务价值的私人信息，并且有追随者（例如，另一个代理人、第三方或委托人）也为该任务做出贡献。代理人的努力可以作为价值的信号，正如以身作则文献中所讨论的那样（Hermalin, 1998）。我们推导出委托人提供高能激励以缓解代理人过度信号的条件。

articles.title_en: Label or taxes: Why not both? Testing nutritional mixed policies in the lab
articles.title_cn: 标签还是税收：为何不两者兼用？实验室中的营养混合政策测试
articles.abstract_en: We run an incentivized framed laboratory experiment to evaluate the interaction of labelling (Nutri-Score) and pricing policies (fat taxes and thin subsidies) on the food shopping of a sample of French consumers. Taxes and subsidies, designed to fit Nutri-Score, are differentiated according to their magnitude (large or small), and their salience (explicit or implicit). We exploit a difference-in-difference design, whereby subjects shop for real from a catalog of 290 products twice, first without any labelling nor pricing policy, and then a second time with one of five different combinations of labelling and pricing policies. Results show that: (i) when implemented alone, taxes and subsidies are less effective than labelling, especially when implicit and when small in magnitude; (ii) policies mixing pricing and labelling are strongly sub-additive; (iii) consumers would benefit from such policies in terms of expenditure at the expense of the State.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们进行了一项激励性的框架实验室实验，以评估标签（Nutri-Score）和定价政策（脂肪税和瘦补贴）对法国消费者样本食品购物行为的交互作用。税收和补贴旨在与Nutri-Score相匹配，并根据其幅度（大或小）和显著性（显性或隐性）进行区分。我们利用双重差分设计，受试者从包含290种产品的目录中真实购物两次，第一次没有任何标签或定价政策，第二次则采用五种不同的标签与定价政策组合之一。结果表明：（i）当单独实施时，税收和补贴的效果不如标签，尤其是在隐性且幅度较小的情况下；（ii）将定价与标签混合的政策具有强烈的次可加性；（iii）消费者在支出方面将从此类政策中受益，但代价由国家承担。

articles.title_en: How should I know? Lack of confidence biases stock market expectations toward zero
articles.abstract_en: Consumers’ expectations of stock market movements are important for understanding individual decisions about consequential financial outcomes and forming economic policy. Across three studies, we posit a new relationship underlying reported stock market expectations: that respondents lack confidence about their ability to forecast stock market movements and this lack of confidence biases reported probabilities toward 0 %. In Study 1, using 10 years of nationally representative survey data, we show that stock market expectations are more pessimistic than warranted when compared to actual stock market movements. In Study 2, we measure stock market expectations in several nationally representative survey experiments over 12 monthly waves (n = 4,613 participants providing 21,670 survey responses) where participants are randomly assigned to report the chances that the stock market will be “lower” or “higher” over the next month and year. Reported probabilities are biased toward 0 % in each question frame, yielding a “framing effect” gap of >10 percentage points each wave. In Study 3, we find that confidence moderates this framing effect: when we manipulate confidence regarding one's ability to forecast the stock market, there is a smaller gap between “lower” and “higher” frames for those participants who have greater confidence. To our knowledge, this is the first research showing that a lack of confidence biases reported stock market probabilities toward 0 %. It also uncovers a framing effect that is counter to psychological theory on “valence framing” and helps explain prior research showing that people are pessimistic about the stock market.

articles.title_en: Synchronization of endogenous business cycles
articles.title_cn: 内生经济周期的同步化
articles.abstract_en: Business cycles tend to comove across countries. However, standard models that attribute comovement to propagation of exogenous shocks struggle to generate a level of comovement that is as high as in the data. In this paper, we consider models that produce business cycles endogenously, through some form of non-linear dynamics—limit cycles or chaos. These models generate stronger comovement, because they combine shock propagation with synchronization of endogenous dynamics. In particular, we study a demand-driven reduced-form model in which business cycles emerge from strategic complementarities within countries, synchronizing their oscillations through international trade linkages. We develop an eigendecomposition that explores the interplay between non-linear dynamics, shock propagation and network structure, and use this theory to understand the mechanisms of synchronization. Next, we calibrate the model to data on 24 countries and show that the empirical level of comovement can only be matched by combining endogenous business cycles with exogenous shocks. Despite the limitations of using a stylized model, our results support the hypothesis that business cycles are at least in part caused by underlying non-linear dynamics.
articles.abstract_cn: 经济周期往往在国家间共同波动。然而，将共同波动归因于外生冲击传播的标准模型难以产生与数据中一样高的共同波动水平。在本文中，我们考虑通过某种非线性动力学形式——极限环或混沌——内生地产生经济周期的模型。这些模型产生更强的共同波动，因为它们将冲击传播与内生动力学的同步化结合起来。具体而言，我们研究了一个需求驱动的简化形式模型，其中经济周期源于国家内部的战略互补性，通过国际贸易联系使其振荡同步化。我们开发了一种特征分解方法，探讨非线性动力学、冲击传播和网络结构之间的相互作用，并利用这一理论来理解同步化的机制。接下来，我们将模型校准到24个国家的数据，并表明经验上的共同波动水平只能通过将内生经济周期与外生冲击相结合来匹配。尽管使用风格化模型存在局限性，我们的结果支持了经济周期至少部分由潜在非线性动力学引起的假设。

articles.title_en: Inequality, social mobility and redistributive preferences
articles.title_cn: 不平等、社会流动性与再分配偏好
articles.abstract_en: In an online experiment, we provide US citizens with information on both inequality of outcomes and opportunities and test the impact on preferences for redistribution. Information on wealth inequalities in the US increases consensus on a more progressive tax system, whereas information on lack of social mobility in the US increases participants’ preferences for redistribution via fiscal spending. Both informational treatments have a stronger impact when participants also learn that higher inequality is not a necessary part of economic development. All informational treatments have a stronger impact for citizens who underestimate the current level of inequality, trust the government, or belong to the middle-income group, while there is no clear relationship between political position and the impact of information on preferences for redistribution.
articles.abstract_cn: 在一项在线实验中，我们向美国公民提供关于结果不平等和机会不平等的信息，并测试其对再分配偏好的影响。关于美国财富不平等的信息增加了对更累进税制的共识，而关于美国缺乏社会流动性的信息则增加了参与者通过财政支出进行再分配的偏好。当参与者还了解到更高的不平等并非经济发展的必要组成部分时，两种信息处理的影响都更强。所有信息处理对低估当前不平等水平、信任政府或属于中等收入群体的公民影响更强，而政治立场与信息对再分配偏好影响之间没有明确关系。

articles.title_en: The impact of search frictions in experimental asset markets: Over-the-counter versus double auction
articles.title_cn: 实验资产市场中搜索摩擦的影响：场外交易与双重拍卖
articles.abstract_en: This paper compares the performance of a centralized trading institution, Double Auction (DA), with a decentralized Over-the-Counter (OTC) trading institution in experimental asset markets. Variants of both are commonly used in field financial markets. While bids and asks are publicly displayed in the DA, they are only visible to the parties involved in a trade in the OTC market due to search frictions. We study the impact of these trading institutions on transaction prices, mispricing, trade volume, and bubble measures in controlled laboratory long-lived asset markets. We find that transaction prices, mispricing, trade volume and some bubble measures are significantly lower in OTC than in DA markets, due to reduced trading activities and stronger selling pressures brought about by search frictions.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文比较了集中交易制度——双重拍卖（DA）与分散的场外交易（OTC）制度在实验资产市场中的表现。两者的变体在实地金融市场中普遍使用。在DA中，出价和要价公开显示，而在OTC市场中，由于搜索摩擦，这些信息仅对交易双方可见。我们研究了这些交易制度对受控实验室长期资产市场中的交易价格、错误定价、交易量和泡沫度量的影响。我们发现，由于搜索摩擦导致的交易活动减少和更强的卖出压力，OTC市场的交易价格、错误定价、交易量和某些泡沫度量显著低于DA市场。

articles.title_en: Not always a Panacea: History education and identity-building in Taiwan
articles.title_cn: 并非总是灵丹妙药：台湾的历史教育与身份建构
articles.abstract_en: We study the impact of history curricula on national identity in Taiwan. The high school curriculum reform of September 2006 separates the history of Taiwan from Chinese chronology and increases Taiwan-oriented content to transmit Taiwanese identity. We document an unintended “backlash” that individuals studying the new curriculum are more likely to hold both greater Taiwanese and Chinese identities. Our analysis suggests endogenous changes in information demand as a prominent mechanism: treated high schoolers show greater identity awareness and acquire more information related to both identities. We further observe consistent attitudinal changes, with milder political views and an increase in votes for median candidates or abstention.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了历史课程对台湾国家认同的影响。2006年九月的高中课程改革将台湾历史与中国历史纪年分离，并增加以台湾为中心的内容以传递台湾认同。我们记录了一种意外的“反弹效应”，即学习新课程的个人更可能同时持有更强的台湾认同和中国认同。我们的分析表明，信息需求的内生变化是一个显著机制：受课程改革影响的高中生表现出更强的身份意识，并获取更多与两种身份相关的信息。我们进一步观察到一致的态度变化，表现为政治观点更为温和，以及投票给中间候选人或弃权的比例增加。

articles.title_en: Strategic use of the second-tier patent system for short life-cycle technologies — Evidence from parallel filings in China
articles.title_cn: 二级专利制度在短生命周期技术中的战略运用——来自中国平行申请的实证
articles.abstract_en: The second-tier patent system, characterized by relatively low protectability standards, has been adopted by many countries, yet empirical analyses of its utilization are scarce. Utilizing Chinese patent data, this study explores “parallel filings” where a second-tier patent is filed simultaneously with an invention patent, to shed light on its practical use. The findings suggest that while parallel filings generally cover inventions with a narrower scope, they receive more citations and are more frequently licensed or transferred in their early years compared to standard patents. This study posits that parallel filing is a strategic choice for technologies with short life cycles that rapidly gain but quickly lose value. The swift issuance of second-tier patents aids in the diffusion of knowledge and technology transfer, enabling patentees to capitalize on fast-evolving technologies. This study contributes valuable empirical insights into how the second-tier patent system supports short life-cycle technologies.
articles.abstract_cn: 二级专利制度以相对较低的可保护性标准为特征，已被许多国家采用，但对其利用的实证分析却很少。利用中国专利数据，本研究探讨了“平行申请”，即二级专利与发明专利同时提交的情况，以揭示其实际用途。研究结果表明，尽管平行申请通常覆盖范围较窄的发明，但与标准专利相比，它们在早期获得更多引用，并且更频繁地被许可或转让。本研究认为，平行申请是短生命周期技术的战略选择，这些技术迅速获得价值但迅速失去价值。二级专利的快速授权有助于知识和技术的传播，使专利权人能够利用快速发展的技术。本研究为二级专利制度如何支持短生命周期技术提供了宝贵的实证见解。

articles.title_en: The impact of prudential regulation on the UK housing market and economy: Insights from an agent-based model
articles.title_cn: 审慎监管对英国住房市场和经济的影响：基于主体模型的见解
articles.abstract_en: We develop a macroeconomic agent-based model to study the joint impact of borrower- and lender-based prudential policies on the housing and credit markets and the economy more widely. We perform three experiments: (i) an increase of total capital requirements; (ii) an introduction of a loan-to-income (LTI) cap on mortgages to owner–occupiers; and (iii) a joint introduction of both experiments at the same time. Our results suggest that tightening capital requirements leads to a sharp decrease in commercial and mortgage lending, and housing transactions. When the LTI cap is in place, house prices fall sharply relative to income, and the homeownership rate decreases. When both policy instruments are combined, we find that housing transactions and prices drop. Both policies have a positive impact on real GDP and unemployment, while there is no material impact on inflation and the real interest rate.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一个宏观经济主体模型，以研究基于借款人和贷款人的审慎政策对住房和信贷市场以及更广泛经济的联合影响。我们进行了三项实验：（i）提高总资本要求；（ii）对自住业主的抵押贷款引入贷款收入比（LTI）上限；（iii）同时引入上述两项实验。我们的结果表明，收紧资本要求会导致商业和抵押贷款以及住房交易量急剧下降。当实施LTI上限时，房价相对于收入大幅下降，住房拥有率降低。当两种政策工具结合时，我们发现住房交易量和价格下降。两项政策对实际GDP和失业率都有积极影响，而对通胀和实际利率没有实质性影响。

articles.title_en: The social value of information uncertainty
articles.title_cn: 信息不确定性的社会价值
articles.abstract_en: We analyze the welfare implication of information acquisition uncertainty in a Grossman–Stiglitz economy with endowment shocks. Investors make optimal probabilistic information acquisition choices subject to an increasing and convex monetary cost. This uncertainty gives rise to an anticipatory benefit so that informed trading can improve social welfare. Although informed trading distorts risk-sharing and destroys trading opportunities, the welfare improvement can be significant when investors have weak risk-sharing incentives, the endowment shocks are small and less informative about the aggregate endowment, and the risky payoff information is more noisy. Moreover, with heterogeneous endowments, there can be a continuum of Pareto optimal information-acquisition equilibria. Therefore, regulations aiming to level the playing field must be exercised with caution.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们分析了在具有禀赋冲击的格罗斯曼-斯蒂格利茨经济中，信息获取不确定性的福利含义。投资者在递增且凸的货币成本约束下，做出最优的概率性信息获取选择。这种不确定性产生了预期性收益，使得知情交易能够改善社会福利。尽管知情交易扭曲了风险分担并破坏了交易机会，但当投资者的风险分担激励较弱、禀赋冲击较小且对总禀赋的信息含量较低，以及风险收益信息噪声较大时，福利改善可能显著。此外，在异质性禀赋下，可能存在连续的帕累托最优信息获取均衡。因此，旨在公平竞争环境的监管措施必须谨慎实施。

articles.title_en: The cost of the COVID-19 crisis: Lockdowns, macroeconomic expectations, and consumer spending
articles.title_cn: COVID-19危机的代价：封锁、宏观经济预期与消费者支出
articles.abstract_en: We study how the differential timing of local lockdowns due to COVID-19 causally affects households’ spending and macroeconomic expectations at the local level using several waves of a customized survey with more than 10,000 respondents. About 50 % of survey participants reported income and wealth losses due to the corona virus, with the average losses being $5,293 and $33,482 respectively. Aggregate consumer spending dropped by 31 log percentage points with the largest drops in travel and clothing. We find that households living in counties that went into lockdown earlier expected the unemployment rate over the next twelve months to be 13 percentage points higher and continued to expect higher unemployment at horizons of three to five years. They also expected lower future inflation, reported higher uncertainty, expected lower mortgage rates for up to 10 years, and had moved out of foreign stocks into liquid forms of savings. The imposition of lockdowns can account for much of the decline in employment during the crisis as well as declines in consumer spending. While lockdowns had pronounced effects on local economic conditions and households’ expectations, they had little impact on approval ratings of Congress, the Fed, or the Treasury but led to declines in the approval of the President.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用一项包含超过19名受访者的定制调查的多轮数据，研究因COVID-10,000导致的地方封锁时间差异如何因果性地影响家庭支出和宏观经济预期。约50的调查参与者报告了因冠状病毒导致的收入和财富损失，平均损失分别为5,293美元和33,482美元。总消费支出下降了31个对数百分点，其中旅行和服装支出降幅最大。我们发现，居住在较早进入封锁的县的家庭，预期未来十二个月的失业率高出13个百分点，并继续预期三至五年的失业率更高。他们还预期未来通胀更低，报告了更高的不确定性，预期抵押贷款利率在长达10年内更低，并将外国股票转为流动性储蓄形式。封锁的实施可以解释危机期间就业下降以及消费支出下降的很大一部分。虽然封锁对地方经济条件和家庭预期产生了显著影响，但对国会、美联储或财政部的支持率影响甚微，但导致总统支持率下降。

articles.title_en: The role of repugnance in markets: How the Jared Fogle scandal affected patronage of subway
articles.title_cn: 厌恶在市场中的作用：贾里德·福格尔丑闻如何影响赛百味的顾客光顾
articles.abstract_en: Economics has long studied how consumers respond to the disclosure of information about firms. We study a case in which the disclosed information is unrelated to the firm's products or leadership, but which could still potentially affect consumer patronage through the mechanism of repugnance, as described in Roth (2007). The information in this case concerns the arrest of Jared Fogle, the well-known spokesman and advertising pitchman for the Subway sandwich franchise, who was arrested in 2015 on charges of sex with a minor and child pornography. We study how the disclosure of this information, which was widely covered in the media, affected patronage of Subway. We estimate synthetic control models using data from a large nationwide survey of consumers regarding the restaurants they patronize. Despite the close and long-standing association of Jared Fogle with Subway, and heavy publicity of his crimes, we consistently fail to detect any effect of the Jared Fogle scandal on the probability of visiting a Subway restaurant. These results contrast with predictions made at the time by industry observers as well as by the public in an original survey and are in contrast to several previous studies of the impact of negative information disclosure on firms. The absence of an effect in this case suggests that repugnance did not drive demand, and that consumers largely separated the offenses of a symbol of the firm from the products of the firm.
articles.abstract_cn: 经济学长期以来一直在研究消费者如何应对企业信息披露。我们研究了一个案例，其中披露的信息与企业的产品或领导层无关，但通过厌恶机制仍可能潜在地影响消费者的光顾，如Roth（2007）所述。此案例中的信息涉及赛百味三明治特许经营店的知名代言人和广告宣传员贾里德·福格尔的被捕，他于2015年因与未成年人发生性关系及持有儿童色情物品的指控而被捕。我们研究了这一被媒体广泛报道的信息披露如何影响赛百味的顾客光顾。我们使用一项大型全国性消费者调查数据（涉及他们光顾的餐厅）来估计合成控制模型。尽管贾里德·福格尔与赛百味有着密切且长期的关联，且其罪行受到大量宣传，我们始终未能检测到贾里德·福格尔丑闻对访问赛百味餐厅概率的任何影响。这些结果与当时行业观察者以及一项原始调查中公众的预测形成对比，也与先前几项关于负面信息披露对企业影响的研究形成对比。在此案例中未发现影响表明，厌恶并未驱动需求，消费者在很大程度上将企业象征的违法行为与企业的产品区分开来。

articles.title_en: The aging society: Is growth reverting to pre-industrial levels in the 21st century?
articles.title_cn: 老龄化社会：21世纪增长是否会回归前工业化水平？
articles.abstract_en: The aging population is expected by many to put an end to the high growth rates experienced in the past century. This paper shows that the aging population and the associated educational and innovative expansion induced by the demographic transition will expand the technology frontier in the 21st century and significantly override the adverse income effects of the aging population. To achieve this, the total income-effects through the channels of innovations, investment, education, and labor force participation are estimated using data over two centuries for 21 OECD countries.
articles.abstract_cn: 许多人预期人口老龄化将终结过去一个世纪经历的高增长率。本文表明，人口老龄化以及由人口转变引发的教育和创新扩张将在21世纪扩展技术前沿，并显著抵消人口老龄化对收入的不利影响。为实现这一目标，本文利用21个OECD国家两个世纪的数据，估计了通过创新、投资、教育和劳动力参与渠道产生的总收入效应。

articles.title_en: Alternative investment behavior of households during crises: The effects of the COVID-19 shock on gold purchases in India
articles.title_cn: 危机期间家庭的非传统投资行为：COVID-19冲击对印度黄金购买的影响
articles.abstract_en: Gold plays an important role as a hedge and a safe haven for investors. This paper presents new evidence on gold’s role for Indian households during the COVID-19 pandemic. By using panel and cross-sectional household surveys, we investigate the propensity of households to purchase, pledge or sell gold based on the district-level heterogeneity in COVID cases and economic impact proxied by night-time light activity. We find higher gold purchases of households in the more affected districts compared to other districts during the crisis. Importantly, households that are more directly affected by the shock are less likely to purchase gold and more likely to pledge or sell gold. The purchases are likely driven by an increased risk perception of households in response to an unexpected shock — a novel perspective of gold’s safe haven property. We also find that relatively poor households that receive government transfers or have less access to formal credit display stronger gold purchasing behavior.
articles.abstract_cn: 黄金在投资者中扮演着对冲和避险的重要角色。本文提供了COVID-19大流行期间黄金对印度家庭作用的新证据。通过使用面板和横截面家庭调查，我们基于地区级别的COVID病例异质性和以夜间灯光活动作为经济影响的代理变量，研究了家庭购买、质押或出售黄金的倾向。我们发现，在危机期间，受影响较严重的地区的家庭相比其他地区有更高的黄金购买量。重要的是，更直接受到冲击影响的家庭购买黄金的可能性较低，而更可能质押或出售黄金。购买行为很可能由家庭对意外冲击的风险感知增强所驱动——这是对黄金避险属性的一个新视角。我们还发现，接受政府转移支付或较少获得正规信贷的相对贫困家庭表现出更强的黄金购买行为。

articles.title_en: Intermediated trade and innovation
articles.title_cn: 中介贸易与创新
articles.abstract_en: This study investigates how intermediaries shape exporters’ innovation decisions. Evidence from Chinese manufacturing firms suggests that direct exporters exhibit more innovation than those exporting indirectly through intermediaries. In addition, the transition from indirect to direct exporting correlates with higher innovation growth. To explain these facts, we develop a model incorporating international trade intermediaries and heterogeneous producers. The model demonstrates that direct exporting provides more incentives for firms to innovate than indirect exporting. Trade liberalization can encourage indirect exporters to switch to direct exporting, thereby promoting innovation. We test the empirical validity of the model’s predictions and quantify the aggregate impact of the innovation premium of direct exporters. This research provides a new viewpoint on trade liberalization and innovation.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨了中介机构如何影响出口商的创新决策。来自中国制造业企业的证据表明，直接出口商比通过中介间接出口的企业展现出更多的创新。此外，从间接出口转向直接出口与更高的创新增长相关。为解释这些事实，我们构建了一个包含国际贸易中介和异质性生产者的模型。模型表明，直接出口比间接出口为企业提供更多创新激励。贸易自由化可以鼓励间接出口商转向直接出口，从而促进创新。我们检验了模型预测的实证有效性，并量化了直接出口商创新溢价的总体影响。本研究为贸易自由化与创新提供了新视角。

articles.title_en: Add and rule
articles.title_cn: 加法与统治
articles.abstract_en: We suggest a new mechanism to explain political and economic inequality in resource rich countries. The mechanism is based on the premise that migrants are treated less generously in autocracies than in democracies. As a consequence, democracies want fewer migrants than autocracies. After democratization a new government may therefore start out with (potentially many) more migrants than their preferred level. These excess migrants, inherited from the autocracy, represent a costly legacy that makes democracy less attractive to citizens. With democracy less attractive, it is cheaper to compensate citizens for not challenging the autocratic regime. Not only that — by adding even more migrants, democratization becomes even less attractive, enabling the ruler to keep even more of the resource rents for himself without a threat of losing power.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种新机制来解释资源丰富国家中的政治和经济不平等。该机制基于这样一个前提：在专制国家中，移民受到的待遇不如民主国家慷慨。因此，民主国家希望比专制国家拥有更少的移民。民主化后，新政府可能因此开始拥有（可能很多）超过其偏好水平的移民。这些从专制政权继承来的多余移民，代表了一种昂贵的遗产，使得民主对公民的吸引力降低。由于民主吸引力下降，补偿公民不挑战专制政权的成本更低。不仅如此——通过增加更多移民，民主化变得更加不具吸引力，从而使统治者能够在没有失去权力威胁的情况下，为自己保留更多的资源租金。

articles.title_en: The marginal utility of income and homogeneous demand systems
articles.title_cn: 收入的边际效用与齐次需求系统
articles.abstract_en: It is important for policymakers and researchers to know how the marginal utility of a population changes with income. This effect is measured by the elasticity of marginal utility of income and is a key parameter in, for examples, cost–benefit analysis, optimal taxation, and measurement of inequality. This paper proposes and applies a demand systems approach to estimate the elasticity of marginal utility of income. Using the PSID survey data for representative samples of households in the United States, I estimate the elasticity of marginal utility of income over households to approximately 0.58.
articles.abstract_cn: 对于政策制定者和研究人员来说，了解人口的边际效用如何随收入变化至关重要。这一效应通过收入边际效用弹性来衡量，并且是成本效益分析、最优税收和 inequality 测量等中的关键参数。本文提出并应用一种需求系统方法来估计收入边际效用的弹性。利用美国代表性家庭样本的 PSID 调查数据，我估计了家庭间收入边际效用的弹性约为 0.58。

articles.title_en: When happy people make society unhappy: Emotions affect tax compliance behavior
articles.title_cn: 当快乐的人使社会不快乐：情绪影响税收遵从行为
articles.abstract_en: Emotions affect judgments and decision making. Our paper presents a study to show that incidental background emotions (i.e., emotions not related to the actual decision) influence individuals’ tax compliance attitudes and behavior. A large-scale survey of 22,220 German taxpayers and a controlled laboratory experiment provide evidence that positive background emotions reduce willingness to comply compared to aversive (negative) background emotions. The participants in our survey show less favorable tax compliance attitudes on weekends, which are usually associated with more positive background emotions. These findings are supported by the results of a controlled laboratory experiment in which background emotions were induced by standardized pictures. Individuals choose to evade taxes more often after being exposed to positive emotions than after being exposed to aversive emotions.
articles.abstract_cn: 情绪影响判断和决策。我们的论文呈现了一项研究，表明偶发背景情绪（即与实际决策无关的情绪）影响个体的税收遵从态度和行为。一项针对22,220名德国纳税人的大规模调查和一项受控实验室实验提供证据表明，与厌恶（负面）背景情绪相比，正面背景情绪降低了遵从意愿。我们调查中的参与者在周末表现出较不有利的税收遵从态度，而周末通常与更积极的背景情绪相关。这些发现得到了受控实验室实验结果的支撑，在该实验中，背景情绪通过标准化图片诱导。个体在接触正面情绪后比接触厌恶情绪后更常选择逃税。

articles.title_en: Turning non-members into members: Do public subsidies to union membership matter?
articles.title_cn: 将非会员转变为会员：对工会会员的公共补贴是否重要？
articles.abstract_en: Using linked employer-employee data for Norway's private sector we estimate the impact of changes in tax subsidies for union membership on individuals’ membership probabilities. Increased subsidisation of the union members increases union take-up, while increased union fees reduce the demand for membership. The subsidy elasticity of demand for union membership was 0.29 in 2012, though effects are heterogeneous across workers. In the absence of the hikes in tax subsidies and holding workforce composition constant aggregate private sector union membership density would have fallen by 5 percentage points between 2001 and 2012. The elasticity of union membership with respect to subsidies is higher in segments of the labour market where unions have low representation in the first place, such as among temporary workers, youth, immigrants, and among workers in low-wage firms.
articles.abstract_cn: 利用挪威私营部门的关联雇主-雇员数据，我们估计了工会会员税收补贴变化对个人会员概率的影响。增加对工会会员的补贴提高了工会的加入率，而工会费用的增加则降低了对会员资格的需求。2012年，工会会员需求的补贴弹性为0.29，尽管不同工人之间的效应存在异质性。在没有税收补贴增加且保持劳动力构成不变的情况下，2001年至2012年间，私营部门工会会员密度的总体水平将下降5个百分点。工会会员相对于补贴的弹性在工会代表性原本较低劳动力市场细分中更高，例如在临时工、青年、移民以及低工资企业的工人中。

articles.title_en: Online versus offline: Which networks spur protests?
articles.title_cn: 线上与线下：哪种网络更能激发抗议？
articles.abstract_en: Does social media or real-life social contacts overcome collective action problems more effectively, when both types of networks are prevalent? We investigate non-violent protests against an economic reform in Austria—a country where one in two citizens uses Facebook but also one in two citizens is a member of a local club or civic organization. The reform only affected individual municipalities, while others remained unaffected. Our results show that protests spread more in reform-affected municipalities with strong offline networks such as village, folklore, or dialect clubs. We do not find that social media penetration intensifies local protests. Descriptive evidence from microdata corroborate these findings. We conclude that offline networks remain important in local contexts, even in an increasingly digital world.
articles.abstract_cn: 当两种类型的网络都普遍存在时，社交媒体还是现实生活中的社会联系能更有效地克服集体行动问题？我们调查了奥地利一场针对经济改革的非暴力抗议——在这个国家，每两个公民中就有一个使用Facebook，但每两个公民中也有一位是当地俱乐部或公民组织的成员。该改革仅影响了特定的市镇，而其他市镇未受影响。我们的结果显示，在改革影响的市镇中，拥有强大线下网络（如村庄、民俗或方言俱乐部）的抗议活动传播更广。我们没有发现社交媒体渗透加剧了地方抗议。来自微观数据的描述性证据证实了这些发现。我们得出结论，即使在日益数字化的世界中，线下网络在地方情境中仍然重要。

articles.title_en: Behavioral spillovers
articles.title_cn: 行为溢出效应
articles.abstract_en: What is a behavioral spillover? How can a spillover be uncovered from the data? What is the precise link between the underlying psychological theory of a spillover and the econometric assumptions which are necessary to estimate it? This paper draws on recent advancements in causal inference, behavioral economics, psychology, and neuroscience to develop a framework for the causal evaluation and interpretation of behavioral spillovers. A novel empirical research design is suggested and a guide for the empirical researcher is developed. Using this guide, the paper reevaluates a large number of existing empirical results and suggests an agenda for future research.
articles.abstract_cn: 什么是行为溢出效应？如何从数据中发现溢出效应？溢出效应的潜在心理学理论与估计其所需的经济计量假设之间的精确联系是什么？本文借鉴因果推断、行为经济学、心理学和神经科学的最新进展，构建了一个用于行为溢出效应因果评估和解释的框架。提出了一种新颖的实证研究设计，并为实证研究者制定了一份指南。利用该指南，本文重新评估了大量现有实证结果，并提出了未来研究的议程。

articles.title_en: Industrial robots, supply chain spillover effect and firm employment: Evidence from China
articles.title_cn: 工业机器人、供应链溢出效应与企业就业：来自中国的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper constructs the supplier-customer matching data for Chinese listed firms to examine the impact of the customer robot adoption on the supplier employment from the perspective of supply chain. On the one hand, customer robot adoption generates negative capital spillover effect, decreasing the employment of suppliers through financial distress contagion and relative bargaining power reduction; on the other hand, customer robot adoption generates positive information spillover effect, enhancing the employment of high-skilled labor of suppliers through market signaling and information sharing. The empirical results show that the capital spillover effect of customer robot adoption is dominant, and thus customer robot adoption significantly reduces the employment of suppliers. Furthermore, we find that customer concentration can reinforce the supply spillover effect, and customer robot adoption has a stronger employment disincentive effect on supplier firms that are in low-tech industries, highly labor-intensive, located in regions with less market segmentation, and geographically close to each other. This paper further investigates the impact of customer robot adoption on the structure of supplier employment, and demonstrate that customer robot adoption significantly increases the proportion of suppliers’ high-skilled labor force, which helps to optimize the structure of supplier employment.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文构建了中国上市公司的供应商-客户匹配数据，从供应链视角考察客户机器人采用对供应商就业的影响。一方面，客户机器人采用产生负向资本溢出效应，通过财务困境传染和相对议价能力降低减少供应商就业；另一方面，客户机器人采用产生正向信息溢出效应，通过市场信号和信息共享提升供应商高技能劳动力就业。实证结果表明，客户机器人采用的资本溢出效应占主导地位，因此客户机器人采用显著减少了供应商就业。此外，我们发现客户集中度会强化供应链溢出效应，且客户机器人采用对处于低技术行业、高度劳动密集型、位于市场分割程度较低地区以及地理上相互接近的供应商企业具有更强的就业抑制效应。本文进一步考察了客户机器人采用对供应商就业结构的影响，并证明客户机器人采用显著提高了供应商高技能劳动力占比，这有助于优化供应商就业结构。

articles.title_en: Trading off autonomy and efficiency in choice architectures: Self-nudging versus social nudging
articles.title_cn: 在选择架构中权衡自主性和效率：自我推动与社会推动
articles.abstract_en: To overcome ethical objections to choice architecture interventions, Thaler and Sunstein (2008) suggest asking individuals to set their own nudge autonomously. Our online experiment (n=1080) faithfully implements this idea for social dilemmas where individual and collective interests often diverge and social nudges can conflict with autonomy. General-population subjects play a ten-round, ten-day public goods game. Non-participation triggers default contributions. We test three default nudges: An exogenous selfish nudge of zero contribution, an exogenous social nudge of full contribution, and an autonomous self-nudge where subjects select their own default contribution. Their performance is tested under four different information structures. We, first, document default choice under autonomy: Only between three and eight percent of subjects set their own default to either zero or full contribution. Second, autonomy and efficiency conflict: Group-level contributions under self-nudging are consistently lower than under the social nudge, which strictly dominates the selfish nudge. When committed to autonomy, the policy-maker – to maximize efficiency – best combines self-nudging with an information structure with public defaults.
articles.abstract_cn: 为了克服对选择架构干预的道德反对，Thaler 和 Sunstein（2008）建议要求个人自主设置自己的推动力。我们的在线实验（n=1080）忠实地实现了这种针对社会困境的想法，在这种困境中，个人和集体利益经常存在分歧，社会推动可能与自治发生冲突。一般人群进行为期十天、十轮的公共物品游戏。不参与会触发默认缴款。我们测试了三种默认助推：零贡献的外源自私助推，全额贡献的外源社会助推，以及受试者选择自己的默认贡献的自主自我助推。它们的性能在四种不同的信息结构下进行了测试。首先，我们记录了自主下的默认选择：只有百分之三到八的受试者将自己的默认设置为零或全额贡献。其次，自主性和效率冲突：自我推动下的群体层面贡献始终低于社会推动下的贡献，而社会推动则严格主导自私推动。当决策者致力于自治时，为了最大限度地提高效率，最好将自我推动与带有公共违约的信息结构结合起来。

articles.title_en: Introduction to JEBO special issue on wars, economic sanctions, economic behaviors, and institutions
Mandate or delegate? the optimal contract for credence goods with the expert’s endeavor
articles.title_cn: 强制还是委托？专家努力下信任品的最优合同
articles.abstract_en: We consider a market for credence goods where a consumer does not know her problem (either major or minor), and an expert can perform a treatment to fix the problem as well as make an effort to improve the effect of treatment. The consumer can offer a contract in which she mandates a specific treatment or a contract which she delegates to the expert who chooses the treatment and is also induced to reveal the consumer’s type. We find that the delegation contract can be the best contract when the high-level treatment is moderately more efficient than the low-level treatment in fixing the minor problem. This is because the delegation contract leads to a more efficient effort decision which can compensate for the efficiency loss from insufficient treatment. Therefore, the consumer may prefer to be under-treated for the minor problem even though the high-level treatment should have been mandated if she had known her type.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考虑一个信任品市场，其中消费者不知道自己的问题（要么是严重的，要么是轻微的），而专家可以进行治疗以解决问题，并付出努力以提高治疗效果。消费者可以提供一份合同，在其中强制规定特定的治疗，或者提供一份委托合同，由专家选择治疗，并被诱导揭示消费者的类型。我们发现，当高水平治疗在解决轻微问题上比低水平治疗适度更有效时，委托合同可以成为最优合同。这是因为委托合同导致了更有效的努力决策，这可以补偿治疗不足带来的效率损失。因此，即使消费者如果知道自己的类型本应被强制要求高水平治疗，她也可能更倾向于对轻微问题接受不足治疗。

articles.title_en: Designing for racial impartiality: The impact of relocating host photos on the Airbnb website
articles.title_cn: 为种族公正而设计：Airbnb网站上房东照片位置调整的影响
articles.abstract_en: This paper assesses the impact of Airbnb’s website redesign policy, which delayed the exposure of host profile photos, on racial discrimination. Using a difference-in-difference design across 10 major US cities, the study finds a negligible reduction in the Black-White price gap. The analysis rejects the possibility of a reduction in the Black-White price gap exceeding 2% with 95% confidence. Additionally, textual analysis of guest reviews indicates no discernible change in guests’ likelihood to leave positive reviews based on host race. Overall, these findings suggest that the policy’s modest increase in search costs was insufficient to change guests’ discriminatory behavior.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文评估了Airbnb网站重新设计政策（延迟展示房东个人资料照片）对种族歧视的影响。利用美国10个主要城市的双重差分设计，研究发现黑白价格差距的减少微乎其微。分析在95%的置信水平下排除了黑白价格差距减少超过2%的可能性。此外，对客人评论的文本分析表明，客人根据房东种族留下正面评价的可能性没有明显变化。总体而言，这些发现表明，该政策带来的搜索成本小幅增加不足以改变客人的歧视行为。

articles.title_en: Does migrant working experience stimulate returnees’ entrepreneurship: Evidence from rural China
articles.title_cn: 外出务工经历是否激发返乡创业：来自中国农村的证据
articles.abstract_en: With an informative dataset describing Chinese rural households from 2003 to 2015, this paper examines the impact of internal rural-to-urban migration for work on the entrepreneurial decisions of returnees. Return migrants are found to be more likely to become transformational rather than subsistence entrepreneurs. To finance their entrepreneurial activities, returnees are more inclined to borrow money in formal credit markets and use their own saving deposits than are those without migrant working experience. Evidence is also presented showing that family connections with a formal civil servant reduce the probability of a returnee's undertaking transformational entrepreneurship, though the connections with a grassroots cadre in the village committee play a positive role. Moreover, the exposure to the New Cooperative Medical Scheme has few effects on households’ entrepreneurship, while the involvement in the New Rural Pension Scheme encourages transformational entrepreneurship.
articles.abstract_cn: 利用一份描述2003年至2015年中国农村家庭的丰富数据集，本文考察了内部农村向城市迁移务工对返乡者创业决策的影响。研究发现，返乡移民更可能成为变革型创业者，而非生存型创业者。为资助其创业活动，返乡者相较于无外出务工经历者，更倾向于在正规信贷市场借款并使用自身储蓄存款。证据还表明，与正式公务员的家庭联系降低了返乡者从事变革型创业的概率，而与村委会基层干部的联系则起到积极作用。此外，参与新型农村合作医疗对家庭创业影响甚微，而参与新型农村社会养老保险则鼓励变革型创业。

articles.title_en: Does preschool TV exposure affect mental health? Evidence from China
articles.title_cn: 学龄前电视暴露是否影响心理健康？来自中国的证据
articles.abstract_en: This study examines the impact of preschool TV exposure on adolescents’ mental health in China. Using data from the 2010 China Family Panel Studies, we exploit geographical variation in the timing of TV introduction across communities to identify the causal effect of preschool TV exposure on mental health and depression of children aged 10 to 15. Our results show that an additional year of preschool TV exposure leads to a 5.94% standard deviation exacerbation in mental illness and a 5.76% standard deviation increase in depression symptoms. The impacts are more pronounced on children with less educated mothers, and with those residing in less developed areas. Further analysis suggests that preschool TV exposure may negatively affect mental health through deteriorating physical health and diminishing cognitive and non-cognitive abilities. This research provides evidence that early childhood experiences, such as exposure to TV at a young age, can have persistent impacts on mental health. Findings also shed light on the origins of mental health inequalities and highlight the importance of early interventions.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究考察了中国学龄前电视暴露对青少年心理健康的影响。利用2010年中国家庭追踪调查数据，我们利用社区间电视引入时间的地理差异来识别学龄前电视暴露对10至15岁儿童心理健康和抑郁的因果效应。结果显示，学龄前电视暴露每增加一年，心理疾病症状标准差恶化5.94%，抑郁症状标准差增加5.76%。这种影响在母亲教育水平较低和居住在经济欠发达地区的儿童中更为显著。进一步分析表明，学龄前电视暴露可能通过损害身体健康和降低认知及非认知能力对心理健康产生负面影响。本研究提供了证据表明，早期童年经历，如年幼时接触电视，可能对心理健康产生持久影响。研究结果也揭示了心理健康不平等的起源，并强调了早期干预的重要性。

articles.title_en: The life-cycle and opportunities of migrants and natives in the Danish experience
articles.title_cn: 丹麦经验中移民与本地人的生命周期与机会
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines income trajectories among migrants from various countries across three generations in Denmark, comparing them to native Danes. Exploiting comprehensive administrative datasets, we investigate economic mobility and evaluate whether Denmark provides economic opportunities for non-natives and their descendants. Our findings indicate that second and third generation immigrants gradually assimilate with Danes but maintain a significant and persistent income gap, contrasting with findings in the United States. We find suggestive evidence that ethnic capital plays a persistent and significant role in explaining these disparities.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考察了丹麦来自不同国家的三代移民的收入轨迹，并与丹麦本地人进行比较。利用全面的行政数据集，我们研究了经济流动性，并评估丹麦是否为非本地人及其后代提供了经济机会。我们的研究结果表明，第二代和第三代移民逐渐与丹麦人同化，但仍保持显著且持续的收入差距，这与美国的研究发现形成对比。我们发现有提示性证据表明，族裔资本在解释这些差异方面发挥着持续且显著的作用。

articles.title_en: Sanctuary policies and the mortgage market behavior: Reducing uncertainty to promote financial inclusion
articles.title_cn: 庇护政策与抵押贷款市场行为：减少不确定性以促进金融包容性
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines the impact of sanctuary policies on the financial inclusion of Hispanics in the U.S. mortgage market. By reducing local cooperation with federal immigration authorities, sanctuary policies reduce the risk of deportation and signal local acceptance of irregular immigrants and their families. This reduction in uncertainty for Hispanic borrowers and profit-maximizing lenders influences decision-making in financial markets. To identify the effect, I take advantage of the staggered implementation of county-level sanctuary policies between 2010 and 2021. Using an event study approach, I find evidence of a significant improvement in financial inclusion in counties that adopted local sanctuary policies. The results are consistent with the literature pointing to a trust spiral created by sanctuary policies and provide novel evidence that such local policies can serve as a tool for improving financial inclusion.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考察了庇护政策对美国抵押贷款市场中西班牙裔金融包容性的影响。通过减少与联邦移民当局的地方合作，庇护政策降低了被驱逐出境的风险，并传递出当地接纳非正规移民及其家庭的信号。这种对西班牙裔借款人和追求利润最大化的贷款方而言不确定性的减少，影响了金融市场中的决策。为识别该效应，我利用了2010年至2021年间县级庇护政策的分阶段实施。采用事件研究方法，我发现了在采纳地方庇护政策的县中金融包容性显著改善的证据。结果与文献中关于庇护政策所创造的信任螺旋的观点一致，并提供了新颖的证据表明此类地方政策可作为改善金融包容性的工具。

articles.title_en: Investigative journalism: Market failures and government intervention through public broadcasters
articles.title_cn: 调查性新闻：市场失灵与政府通过公共广播机构的干预
articles.abstract_en: Investigative journalism plays a vital role in promoting democratic accountability and transparency. This paper surveys nearly 5,000 participants from the U.S., the U.K., and Norway, demonstrating that investigative journalism functions as a public good prone to underprovision. I explore how governments can address this potential market failure through the intervention of public broadcasters. A majority of participants are willing to pay higher taxes to support increased journalism through public broadcasters. However, in countries with well-established public broadcasters, subsidies to private media are preferred, largely due to perceived political non-neutrality. Public broadcasters may garner broader support by focusing their journalism on non-political contexts. A Coasian approach proves ineffective, as the willingness to pay rises with the broader sharing of output.
articles.abstract_cn: 调查性新闻在促进民主问责和透明度方面发挥着至关重要的作用。本文调查了来自美国、英国和挪威的近5,000名参与者，表明调查性新闻作为一种公共物品，容易供给不足。我探讨了政府如何通过公共广播机构的干预来解决这一潜在的市场失灵。大多数参与者愿意支付更高的税收，以支持通过公共广播机构增加新闻报道。然而，在拥有成熟公共广播机构的国家，对私人媒体的补贴更受青睐，这主要是由于感知到的政治非中立性。公共广播机构通过将其新闻报道聚焦于非政治背景，可能获得更广泛的支持。科斯方法被证明无效，因为支付意愿随着产出的更广泛共享而上升。

articles.title_en: Cultural origin and international trade
articles.title_cn: 文化渊源与国际贸易
articles.abstract_en: Employing merged Chinese listed firm data, Chinese custom data, and the prefecture-level clan culture data, we find a clear pattern that chairpersons who originate from a prefecture-level city with a stronger clan culture lead firms to engage in less international trade. This finding is robust to a variety of checks including using the shortest distance from the chairperson's prefecture of origin to the nearest historical Neo-Confucian Academy and the number of southward-migrating clans during the Jianyan Reign (1127–1130) in the origin prefecture as instruments. The patterns in the data highlight the importance of cultural origin in shaping individuals’ attitudes towards international trade.
articles.abstract_cn: 利用合并的中国上市公司数据、中国海关数据以及地级市宗族文化数据，我们发现一个清晰模式：来自宗族文化较强地级市的董事长领导的企业参与国际贸易较少。这一发现在多种检验中均稳健，包括使用董事长原籍地级市到最近的历史新儒学书院的最短距离以及建炎年间（1127-1130）原籍地级市南迁宗族数量作为工具变量。数据中的模式凸显了文化渊源在塑造个人对国际贸易态度方面的重要性。

articles.title_en: Underpricing and perceived scarcity
articles.title_cn: 定价偏低与感知稀缺性
articles.abstract_en: We analyze why firms might set their prices below the market equilibrium levels and thereby create persistent excess demand. In a dynamic setting, if the excess demand results in a perception of scarcity, which is a demand shifter, cumulative discounted profits can be higher over time. Our empirical application is based on data from the market for “cult wines.” We find that the larger the difference between the secondary market price and the winemaker's release price, the higher the secondary market price will be for the same wine in the following year, which consistent with a scarcity-pricing strategy.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们分析企业为何可能将价格设定在低于市场均衡水平之下，从而造成持续的过度需求。在动态环境中，如果过度需求导致稀缺性的感知，而稀缺性是需求转移因素，那么累计折现利润随时间可能更高。我们的实证应用基于“文化酒”市场的数据。我们发现，二级市场价格与酿酒商发布价格之间的差异越大，同一种酒在次年的二级市场价格就越高，这与稀缺性定价策略一致。

articles.title_en: Social networks and experienced inequality
articles.title_cn: 社会网络与经验不平等
articles.abstract_en: Traditional measures of inequality, such as the Gini coefficient, involve pairwise comparisons across all members of a given population. But, most people possess information about, and therefore experience inequality in comparison to, only a subset of the population. In this paper, we provide simple axioms to describe inequality as experienced in social networks. We propose an index to measure aggregate experienced inequality that is consistent with these axioms. We then compute the Gini coefficient and ‘experienced inequality’ in 75 villages in Karnataka, India. We show that for a given wealth distribution, the social network could either accentuate or diminish experienced inequality. We show, first analytically and then empirically, how this can happen with respect to two network properties. Firstly, wealth-based homophily is negatively associated with experienced inequality. Secondly, caste-based homophily is negatively associated with experienced inequality when within-caste inequality is less than the overall Gini coefficient (and positively associated when the opposite is true).
articles.abstract_cn: 传统的不平等度量方法，如基尼系数，涉及对给定人口中所有成员进行两两比较。然而，大多数人只拥有关于人口中一个子集的信息，因此其经验不平等仅相对于该子集而言。在本文中，我们提供简单的公理来描述社会网络中的经验不平等。我们提出一个与这些公理一致的指数来衡量总体经验不平等。然后，我们计算了印度卡纳塔克邦75个村庄的基尼系数和“经验不平等”。我们表明，对于给定的财富分配，社会网络可能加剧或减弱经验不平等。我们首先通过分析，然后通过实证，展示这如何与两个网络属性相关。首先，基于财富的同质性（homophily）与经验不平等呈负相关。其次，当种姓内部不平等小于总体基尼系数时，基于种姓的同质性与经验不平等呈负相关（反之则呈正相关）。

articles.title_en: Opinion dynamics meet agent-based climate economics: An integrated analysis of carbon taxation
articles.title_cn: 观点动态与基于主体的气候经济学：碳税的整合分析
articles.abstract_en: We introduce an integrated approach, blending Opinion Dynamics with a Macroeconomic Agent-Based Model (OD-MABM) to explore the co-evolution of climate change mitigation policy and public support. The OD-MABM links a novel opinion dynamics model that is calibrated for European countries using survey data to the Dystopian Schumpeter meeting Keynes model (DSK). Opinion dynamics regarding climate policy arise from complex interactions among social, political, economic and climate systems where a household’s opinion is affected by individual economic conditions, perception of climate change, industry-led (dis-)information and social influence. We examine 133 policy pathways in the EU, integrating various carbon tax schemes and revenue recycling mechanisms. Our findings reveal that effective carbon tax policies initially lead to a decline in public support due to substantial macroeconomic transition costs, threatening political feasibility. However, they also pave the way for a positive social tipping point in the future. This shift stems from the evolving economic and political influence associated with the fossil fuel-based industry, which gradually diminishes as the transition unfolds. Second, hybrid revenue recycling strategies that combine green subsidies with climate dividends successfully address this intertemporal trade-off in our model by accelerating the transition and mitigating its economic fallout, thus broadening public support.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们引入了一种整合方法，将观点动态与宏观经济基于主体的模型（OD-MABM）相结合，以探索气候变化减缓政策与公众支持的共同演化。OD-MABM将一种新颖的观点动态模型（该模型使用调查数据针对欧洲国家进行校准）与“反乌托邦熊彼特遇见凯恩斯”模型（DSK）相连接。关于气候政策的观点动态源于社会、政治、经济和气候系统之间的复杂相互作用，其中家庭的观点受到个人经济状况、对气候变化的感知、行业主导的（虚假）信息和社会影响的影响。我们考察了欧盟的133条政策路径，整合了各种碳税方案和收入循环机制。我们的研究结果表明，有效的碳税政策最初会因巨大的宏观经济转型成本而导致公众支持下降，从而威胁到政治可行性。然而，它们也为未来积极的社会临界点铺平了道路。这种转变源于与化石燃料行业相关的经济和政治影响力的演变，随着转型的推进，这种影响力逐渐减弱。其次，将绿色补贴与气候红利相结合的混合收入循环策略在我们的模型中成功解决了这一跨期权衡，通过加速转型并减轻其经济后果，从而扩大了公众支持。

articles.title_en: The benefits of coarse preferences
articles.title_cn: 粗偏好之益
articles.abstract_en: We study the strategic benefits of coarsening one’s utility by clustering payoffs together. Our solution concept, coarse-utility equilibrium (CUE) requires that (1) each player maximizes her coarse utility, given the opponent’s strategy, and (2) the classifications form best replies to one another. We characterize CUEs in various games. In particular, we show that there is a qualitative difference between CUEs in which only one of the players clusters payoffs and those in which all players cluster their payoffs, and that, in the latter type of CUE, players treat other players better than they do in Nash equilibria in games with monotone externalities.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了通过将收益聚类来粗化自身效用的战略益处。我们的解概念，粗效用均衡（CUE），要求（1）每个参与者在给定对手策略的情况下最大化其粗效用，且（2）这些分类构成相互的最佳回应。我们在多种博弈中刻画了CUE。特别地，我们表明，在仅有一方参与者聚类收益的CUE与所有参与者均聚类其收益的CUE之间存在质的差异，并且在后者类型的CUE中，参与者在具有单调外部性的博弈中对其他参与者的对待优于纳什均衡中的表现。

articles.title_en: Elasticity of intertemporal substitution in the euro area
articles.title_cn: 欧元区跨期替代弹性
articles.abstract_en: We leverage the unique design of the ECB Consumer Expectations Survey to directly estimate the Elasticity of Intertemporal Substitution (EIS) for the eurozone and its member countries from the consumers’ Euler equation. Our estimates for the euro area fall between 0.7 and 0.8 and remain stable over time after accounting for the excess sensitivity of planned consumption to expected income changes. Excess income sensitivity was particularly strong during the pandemic years but overall it is much less pronounced in the euro area than in the U.S. We also document substantial heterogeneity in both the EIS and excess income sensitivity across eurozone countries. The implications are discussed.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用欧洲央行消费者预期调查的独特设计，直接从消费者的欧拉方程中估计欧元区及其成员国的跨期替代弹性（EIS）。我们的欧元区估计值介于0.7和0.8之间，并且在考虑了计划消费对预期收入变化的过度敏感性后，随时间保持稳定。过度收入敏感性在疫情期间尤为强烈，但总体而言，欧元区的这一现象远不如美国显著。我们还记录了欧元区各国在EIS和过度收入敏感性方面的显著异质性。文中讨论了其影响。
